channel.title: Hürriyet Daily News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Hürriyet Daily News (hurriyetdailynews.com)

item.title: CHP rolls out first party program revamp in 17 years - Türkiye News
item.description: The main opposition Republican People’s Party (CHP) unveiled a new party program on Nov. 21, its first major overhaul in nearly two decades, setting the stage for a pivotal convention next week where delegates will vote on the text.

item.title: The new era of gastronomy: A language that reaches from table to society
item.description: Today, the meaning of gastronomy is no longer shaped by what is cooked, but by how it touches human life. Across the world, a new lens is being placed on the kitchen

item.title: Food poisoning fears grip Istanbul as spate of incidents hits businesses - Türkiye News
item.description: A series of poisoning cases reported over the past weeks, emerging just after the tragic death of a family visiting Istanbul from Germany, has fueled widespread anxiety over food safety and triggered steep economic losses for street vendors, restaurants and hotels in key tourist districts.

item.title: Türkiye’s prudent policies achieve important successes: IMF - Latest News
item.description: The Turkish authorities’ commitment to reduce inflation while protecting growth has brought important successes: Gradual disinflation, improved confidence in the Turkish Lira and replenished buffers, according to the International Monetary Fund (IMF).

item.title: South Korea, Türkiye are 'brotherly nations bound by blood,' says Lee - World News
item.description: South Korean President Lee Jae Myung has said that his country and Türkiye "are brotherly nations bound by blood, having fought side by side to defend freedom and democracy."

item.title: AKP, DEM Party, MHP lawmakers to visit Öcalan on İmralı - Türkiye News
item.description: A delegation of three Turkish lawmakers is scheduled to visit jailed PKK leader Abdullah Öcalan on İmralı Island this week, following approval by the parliamentary commission steering the country’s renewed peace initiative.

item.title: Türkiye takes helm of COP31 after climate diplomacy - Türkiye News
item.description: Türkiye has formally announced that it will host and preside over COP31, days after Australia withdrew its bid to host the United Nations annual climate summit.

item.title: Erdoğan says to hold talks with Putin over Ukraine war - Türkiye News
item.description: President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan said on Sunday that he will speak with Russian leader Vladimir Putin on the phone today as part of efforts to end the war in Ukraine.

item.title: Israel says killed Hezbollah chief of staff in Beirut strike - World News
item.description: Israel said it killed Hezbollah's chief of staff in an air strike on Lebanon's capital on Sunday, hitting an apartment building in an operation the militant group said crossed a red line.

item.title: Trump blasts Ukraine for 'zero gratitude' amid talks to halt war
item.description: U.S. President Donald Trump on Sunday accused Ukraine again of lacking "gratitude" for Washington's support against Russia's invasion, as top U.S. and Ukrainian representatives met in Geneva for talks on a proposal to halt the war.
